Hi Jordan —

Thanks again for taking the time to meet with us this morning. Quick recap and next steps from our end:

- Acme's security team prefers: (1) SOC 2 Type II report or bridge letter, (2) temporary trust portal access to download evidence, and (3) completion of the vendor security questionnaire we discussed.

What I can do immediately:
1) Share a bridge letter while we confirm the latest Type II report availability.
2) Invite your security contacts to our Trust Portal so they can download evidence and our policy docs.
3) Start the vendor security questionnaire flow — you can upload a completed spreadsheet or we can work through it together.

Please confirm the best security contact(s) for access (I have Jordan and Priya listed), and I will send the invite + attach the bridge letter. If you have a preferred deadline for the questionnaire, let me know and we'll prioritize.
